# Companion of lib2_jpeg_sdk: the header parsers' own bounds checks. The marker scanner and the scan
# reader are mocked here and report steered offsets and scan headers, so every length and extent check
# sees both sides of its boundary (with the real scanner these checks are always satisfied first).
# A companion-only copy of the baseline stream varies the Huffman and scan-header lengths and the last
# Huffman code-length count.
# Also the decoder control-size estimator on records that sit exactly on its rounding boundaries, and
# the component derivation on records that differ from its interleaved fast path in one field each.
# readable-scope: 0284C468,0284C6E4,0284C990,0284CB54,0284CC70,0284CE5C,0284CFE0,0284D358,0284D934
# verify: -only 0284C468,0284C6E4,0284C990,0284CB54,0284CC70,0284CE5C,0284CFE0,0284D358,0284D934
src wwhd_src/libjpeg/SdkJpeg.cpp

ret! 0284C260 0,0,0,0xffffffff
